affected_version: Exact published 0.5.2 tarball contains the same unchecked directory enumeration. Runtime failing-before proof used the prepatch candidate; earlier versions unassessed.
invariant: Configured graph document roots and discovered Markdown remain within the repository through traversal, parsing and formatting replacement; a linked directory cannot disclose external node metadata or replace external files.
strategy: Extend the existing shared workspace discovery boundary with contained directory and bounded file reads. Indexing, validation, duplicate-ID planning and both formatting modes recheck reads; formatting preflights all changed destinations and uses contained atomic replacement. Tolerant indexing and repair planning propagate containment failures.
before: 18 of 19 new cases failed before patch, with linked core/design/work/archive roots exposing metadata and both formatting modes replacing owned outside-fixture files. The ordinary discovery control passed.

after.command: npm run build; npm run build:test; workspace containment/indexer/format focused tests
after.result: Initial 30 passed. Expanded installed suite covers all 23 workspace scenarios, including post-discovery leaf substitution, tolerant indexing, both format modes, native names, disabled workspaces and idempotent formatting.

after.command: Offline npm pack/install and external compiled harness against installed CLI/modules
after.result: 23 passed; zero failures/skips; all installed runtime bytes unchanged. Owned fixture and install directories and intermediate tarball removed after retaining the compact receipt.

after.command: TMPDIR=<owned fixture parent> npm run test:built
after.result: 856 main tests and 26 public-release/security-contract checks passed; zero failures/skips. First full run found one old source assertion expecting atomicWriteFile; assertion now requires both format modes to use the contained atomic replacement boundary.

after.command: CLI snapshot and command-contract parity; doc command examples; full and changed-only graph validation; git diff --check
after.result: Passed; 478 examples across 63 files; no graph errors; three inherited full-graph bundle-age warnings and zero changed-only warnings.

installed_candidate.status: Intermediate development artifact; not the final 0.6.0 seal

review: Fresh independent prepatch investigation and one fresh candidate review; no concrete remaining static linked-directory bypass or legitimate regression evidenced. Reviewer ran no code; parent performed execution checks. Separate final exact-range review remains required in task-828.
limitations: Path-based ancestor checks do not provide portable openat race immunity against a concurrent filesystem actor; static-checkout single-writer contract only.
Whole-format atomicity across concurrent changes is not claimed; all known paths are preflighted and each replacement is checked again.
Node 24 matrix, remaining blockers, final security diff review, full release ladder and candidate seal remain pending.
